content: Hello! This is Sarah from Midtown Clinic's billing desk. Are you reaching out regarding your recent payment for invoice #C7812? I can assist with confirming transactions or clarifying any outstanding balances.
Hi Sarah, yes, I just paid my hospital bill of $1,320 through my Wells Fargo online transfer this morning. I want to make sure it was received under the right patient name.

Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Patel. I see a transfer this morning for $1,320 linked to account ending in 6043, matching your patient ID 99245. The transfer reference number 74588316 was recorded at 09:42 AM. We'll apply this to your account and send confirmation to your email: r.patel@fastmail.com.
That's great. My previous payment last month showed up in less than 24 hours, so I'm hoping this is just as quick.

Absolutely, your June 11th payment via PayPal cleared by the next business day, and I expect the same for today's Wells Fargo transfer. If you don't see confirmation by noon tomorrow, please let us know immediately so we can escalate.
Will do. Do I need to keep the transaction receipt?

It's a good idea to hang on to the receipt or the transaction ID 74588316 until you get the official payment confirmation from billing@midtownclinic.org. It rarely happens, but if there's any delay, the ID speeds up our verification.
Understood. Thanks for the help, Sarah.

You're very welcome, Mr. Patel. You're all set for now. If you have any issues or spot a delay past tomorrow, call us directly at 555-231-7781 referencing your account number 99245. Wishing you a speedy recovery!
